textExcerpt: Coursebook Plan lessons for your child here. You teach them; there is no child chat, and answers never reach the learner pages. New lesson plan Courses Library Parent Studio Lesson plans you prepared for your child Two plans can describe the same lesson and still be different plans: each brief you write is kept as its own plan, so you can keep one per child, compare two versions, or start again without losing the first.
